---
title: "Trade cockpit – `r params$reporter` – `r params$year`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d/%m/%Y')`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: false
    theme:
      version: 5
      bg: "#EEF9FD"
      fg: "#271D67"
      primary: "#1AADE7"
      secondary: "#271D67"
      base_font: !expr bslib::font_collection(bslib::font_google("Poppins", local = FALSE), "Segoe UI", "Arial", "sans-serif")
      heading_font: !expr bslib::font_collection(bslib::font_google("Poppins", local = FALSE), "Segoe UI", "Arial", "sans-serif")
params:
  reporter: "Luxembourg"
  year: 2025
  data_path: "final_df.rds"   # .rds holding final_df, next to the Rmd (used when final_df is not found in memory)
  top_n: 20            # partners shown in the bar charts
  heat_n: 30           # partners shown in the heatmap
  evo_default: "BE"    # partner selected when the page opens (annual evolution chart)
  threshold: 0.9       # "Product" tab: cumulative share of the flow to reach (slider in the sidebar)
  agg_path: "code_agg.xlsx"   # geographical aggregates (CODE, Label - English, Note (EN only)); "" = none
  neighbours: ["BE", "FR", "NL", "DE"]   # Summary tab: neighbouring countries (summed)
  excluded_products: ["99"]              # Summary tab: chapters left out of the top 5 (besides TOTAL)
  topojson_url: ""     # optional: folder holding plotly's world_110m.json for an offline map (default = cdn.plot.ly)
---

<!--
Usage
  A. Knit button in RStudio: Knit runs in a fresh R session, so final_df must be on disk.
     Once, in the console:   saveRDS(final_df, "final_df.rds")   (next to this Rmd, or set params$data_path)
  B. From the console with final_df in memory:
     rmarkdown::render("trade_cockpit_LU.Rmd", envir = globalenv())
  C. From an .rds anywhere:
     rmarkdown::render("trade_cockpit_LU.Rmd", params = list(data_path = "M:/.../final_df.rds", year = 2025))

Expected columns in final_df: PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_LABEL, FLOW_CODE, FLOW_LABEL, PARTNER_CODE,
PARTNER_LABEL, TIME, INDICATOR_CODE, VALUE_IN_EUROS (as produced by consolidate_trade_LU.R).
params$agg_path: Excel file of geographical aggregates (code_agg.xlsx: CODE, Label - English,
Note (EN only) listing the member countries, or "= A - B - C" for a difference of aggregates). The
"Country" tab offers these aggregates next to the individual countries. Missing file = countries only.
The cockpit focuses on params$year; the "annual evolution" chart (click a country on the map) uses
every year available in final_df.
The world map base layer is fetched from cdn.plot.ly when the page opens (internet needed), unless
params$topojson_url points to a local copy of plotly's world_110m.json.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

need <- c("tidyverse", "knitr", "plotly", "htmltools", "bslib", "DT", "jsonlite", "crosstalk", "readxl")
missing_pkgs <- need[!need %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"]]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) install.packages(missing_pkgs)

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(plotly)
library(htmltools)
library(DT)
library(jsonlite)
library(crosstalk)
library(readxl)

# ---- Graphic charter ------------------------------------------------------------------------
COL_BG      <- "#EEF9FD"
COL_NAVY    <- "#271D67"   # secondary / text
COL_BLUE    <- "#1AADE7"   # primary
COL_LAVEND  <- "#7B6FD0"
COL_GREY    <- "#8A87A8"
COL_RED     <- "#D7263D"
FONT_FAMILY <- "Poppins, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif"

# Flow colours: one hue per flow, never swapped (checked for colour-blind separation and 3:1 contrast)
FLOW_COLORS <- c(IMPORT = "#0E8FC2", EXPORT = "#D97A06")
FLOW_LABELS <- c(IMPORT = "Imports", EXPORT = "Exports")

# Sequential scale for magnitudes (one hue, light -> dark)
SEQ_SCALE <- list(c(0, "#E6F4FB"), c(0.25, "#A9DCF3"), c(0.5, "#1AADE7"), c(0.75, "#0E6FA6"), c(1, "#271D67"))
# Lighter half of the same ramp, for tiles that carry dark text (treemap)
SEQ_SCALE_LIGHT <- list(c(0, "#EEF7FC"), c(0.5, "#A9DCF3"), c(1, "#5FC4EE"))

KEY_SEP <- "||"

# Crosstalk: the map and the "annual evolution" chart share one selection group, keyed by partner code
CT_GROUP  <- "partner"
SANKEY_N  <- 12          # origins / destinations shown by name in the sankey (the rest = "Other")
```

```{r load-data}
# final_df: taken from the global environment when it is there (rmarkdown::render(..., envir = globalenv())),
# otherwise read from params$data_path. The RStudio "Knit" button renders in a fresh R session, so in that
# case the .rds file is needed: saveRDS(final_df, "final_df.rds").
if (exists("final_df", envir = globalenv(), inherits = FALSE)) {
  final_df <- get("final_df", envir = globalenv())
} else if (nzchar(params$data_path) && file.exists(params$data_path)) {
  final_df <- readRDS(params$data_path)
} else {
  stop(
    "final_df not found.\n",
    "  - Knit button: save it first with  saveRDS(final_df, \"", params$data_path, "\")  next to the Rmd,\n",
    "    or set params$data_path to the .rds file.\n",
    "  - Console: rmarkdown::render(\"trade_cockpit_LU.Rmd\", envir = globalenv())"
  )
}

needed <- c("PRODUCT_CODE", "PRODUCT_LABEL", "FLOW_LABEL", "PARTNER_CODE", "PARTNER_LABEL", "TIME", "VALUE_IN_EUROS")
if (!all(needed %in% names(final_df))) {
  stop("final_df is missing column(s): ", paste(setdiff(needed, names(final_df)), collapse = ", "))
}

# ---- Partner codes: keep real countries only ------------------------------------------------
# Eurostat partner codes = ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, except EL (Greece), UK (United Kingdom) and a few
# non-ISO codes (XK Kosovo, XS Serbia, XM Montenegro...). Everything else (EU27_2020, WORLD,
# EXT_EU, QV/QW/QY/QZ "not specified", QS stores & provisions...) is an aggregate or a
# statistical territory and is dropped. The alpha-3 code is what plotly needs for the world map.
ISO_A3 <- c(
  AD="AND", AE="ARE", AF="AFG", AG="ATG", AI="AIA", AL="ALB", AM="ARM", AO="AGO", AQ="ATA",
  AR="ARG", AS="ASM", AT="AUT", AU="AUS", AW="ABW", AX="ALA", AZ="AZE", BA="BIH", BB="BRB",
  BD="BGD", BE="BEL", BF="BFA", BG="BGR", BH="BHR", BI="BDI", BJ="BEN", BL="BLM", BM="BMU",
  BN="BRN", BO="BOL", BQ="BES", BR="BRA", BS="BHS", BT="BTN", BV="BVT", BW="BWA", BY="BLR",
  BZ="BLZ", CA="CAN", CC="CCK", CD="COD", CF="CAF", CG="COG", CH="CHE", CI="CIV", CK="COK",
  CL="CHL", CM="CMR", CN="CHN", CO="COL", CR="CRI", CU="CUB", CV="CPV", CW="CUW", CX="CXR",
  CY="CYP", CZ="CZE", DE="DEU", DJ="DJI", DK="DNK", DM="DMA", DO="DOM", DZ="DZA", EC="ECU",
  EE="EST", EG="EGY", EH="ESH", ER="ERI", ES="ESP", ET="ETH", FI="FIN", FJ="FJI", FK="FLK",
  FM="FSM", FO="FRO", FR="FRA", GA="GAB", GB="GBR", GD="GRD", GE="GEO", GF="GUF", GG="GGY",
  GH="GHA", GI="GIB", GL="GRL", GM="GMB", GN="GIN", GP="GLP", GQ="GNQ", GR="GRC", GS="SGS",
  GT="GTM", GU="GUM", GW="GNB", GY="GUY", HK="HKG", HM="HMD", HN="HND", HR="HRV", HT="HTI",
  HU="HUN", ID="IDN", IE="IRL", IL="ISR", IM="IMN", IN="IND", IO="IOT", IQ="IRQ", IR="IRN",
  IS="ISL", IT="ITA", JE="JEY", JM="JAM", JO="JOR", JP="JPN", KE="KEN", KG="KGZ", KH="KHM",
  KI="KIR", KM="COM", KN="KNA", KP="PRK", KR="KOR", KW="KWT", KY="CYM", KZ="KAZ", LA="LAO",
  LB="LBN", LC="LCA", LI="LIE", LK="LKA", LR="LBR", LS="LSO", LT="LTU", LU="LUX", LV="LVA",
  LY="LBY", MA="MAR", MC="MCO", MD="MDA", ME="MNE", MF="MAF", MG="MDG", MH="MHL", MK="MKD",
  ML="MLI", MM="MMR", MN="MNG", MO="MAC", MP="MNP", MQ="MTQ", MR="MRT", MS="MSR", MT="MLT",
  MU="MUS", MV="MDV", MW="MWI", MX="MEX", MY="MYS", MZ="MOZ", NC="NCL", NE="NER", NF="NFK",
  NG="NGA", NI="NIC", NL="NLD", NO="NOR", NP="NPL", NR="NRU", NU="NIU", NZ="NZL", OM="OMN",
  PA="PAN", PE="PER", PF="PYF", PG="PNG", PH="PHL", PK="PAK", PL="POL", PM="SPM", PN="PCN",
  PR="PRI", PS="PSE", PT="PRT", PW="PLW", PY="PRY", QA="QAT", RE="REU", RO="ROU", RS="SRB",
  RU="RUS", RW="RWA", SA="SAU", SB="SLB", SC="SYC", SD="SDN", SE="SWE", SG="SGP", SH="SHN",
  SI="SVN", SJ="SJM", SK="SVK", SL="SLE", SM="SMR", SN="SEN", SO="SOM", SR="SUR", SS="SSD",
  ST="STP", SV="SLV", SX="SXM", SY="SYR", SZ="SWZ", TC="TCA", TD="TCD", TF="ATF", TG="TGO",
  TH="THA", TJ="TJK", TK="TKL", TL="TLS", TM="TKM", TN="TUN", TO="TON", TR="TUR", TT="TTO",
  TV="TUV", TW="TWN", TZ="TZA", UA="UKR", UG="UGA", UM="UMI", US="USA", UY="URY", UZ="UZB",
  VA="VAT", VC="VCT", VE="VEN", VG="VGB", VI="VIR", VN="VNM", VU="VUT", WF="WLF", WS="WSM",
  YE="YEM", YT="MYT", ZA="ZAF", ZM="ZMB", ZW="ZWE", "NA"="NAM",
  # Eurostat-specific codes
  EL="GRC", UK="GBR", XK="XKX", XS="SRB", XM="MNE"
)

# Territories kept as separate partners although they have no ISO alpha-3 code: they appear in
# every list, chart and table except the world map (nothing to draw them with).
EXTRA_PARTNERS <- c("XC", "XL")                 # Ceuta, Melilla
partner_keep   <- c(names(ISO_A3), EXTRA_PARTNERS)

raw_all <- final_df %>%
  mutate(
    PARTNER_CODE = if_else(is.na(PARTNER_CODE), "NA", as.character(PARTNER_CODE)),  # Namibia
    TIME         = as.integer(TIME),
    VALUE        = as.numeric(VALUE_IN_EUROS),
    FLOW         = toupper(FLOW_LABEL)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(VALUE), FLOW %in% names(FLOW_COLORS))

raw <- filter(raw_all, TIME == params$year)
if (nrow(raw) == 0) stop("No row for year ", params$year, " in final_df")

excluded_codes <- raw %>%
  filter(!PARTNER_CODE %in% partner_keep) %>%
  distinct(PARTNER_CODE, PARTNER_LABEL) %>%
  arrange(PARTNER_CODE)

trade_all <- raw_all %>%
  filter(PARTNER_CODE %in% partner_keep) %>%
  mutate(
    ISO3    = unname(ISO_A3[PARTNER_CODE]),          # NA for the extra territories
    # "Belgium (incl. Luxembourg 'LU' -> 1998)" -> "Belgium"
    PARTNER = str_squish(str_remove(PARTNER_LABEL, "\\s*\\(.*$"))
  )
trade <- filter(trade_all, TIME == params$year)
years_all <- sort(unique(trade_all$TIME))

# ---- Products ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# "All products": Eurostat's own TOTAL when present, otherwise the sum of the HS2 chapters.
has_total <- "TOTAL" %in% trade$PRODUCT_CODE

products <- trade %>%
  filter(PRODUCT_CODE != "TOTAL") %>%
  distinct(PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_LABEL) %>%
  arrange(PRODUCT_CODE) %>%
  mutate(PRODUCT_NAME = str_to_sentence(PRODUCT_LABEL),
         PRODUCT_NAME = if_else(nchar(PRODUCT_NAME) > 60, paste0(str_sub(PRODUCT_NAME, 1, 57), "..."), PRODUCT_NAME),
         PRODUCT_OPT  = paste0(PRODUCT_CODE, " · ", PRODUCT_NAME))

# One row per product x flow x partner (products + "TOTAL" = all products)
by_partner <- trade %>%
  filter(PRODUCT_CODE != "TOTAL") %>%
  group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW, PARTNER_CODE, PARTNER, ISO3) %>%
  summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop")

total_rows <- if (has_total) {
  trade %>% filter(PRODUCT_CODE == "TOTAL") %>%
    group_by(FLOW, PARTNER_CODE, PARTNER, ISO3) %>%
    summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop")
} else {
  by_partner %>% group_by(FLOW, PARTNER_CODE, PARTNER, ISO3) %>%
    summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop")
}
by_partner <- bind_rows(by_partner, mutate(total_rows, PRODUCT_CODE = "TOTAL")) %>%
  filter(VALUE > 0)

product_keys <- c("TOTAL", products$PRODUCT_CODE)
product_names <- c(TOTAL = "All products", setNames(products$PRODUCT_NAME, products$PRODUCT_CODE))

# Flow totals per product (denominator of the shares)
flow_totals <- by_partner %>% group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW) %>% summarise(TOTAL = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop")

# ---- Partner concentration per product -------------------------------------------------------
# Partners ranked by value within each product x flow, with their cumulative share of the flow.
# The number of partners needed to reach a threshold = first rank whose cumulative share >= threshold.
conc <- by_partner %>%
  group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW) %>%
  arrange(desc(VALUE), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(SHARE = VALUE / sum(VALUE), CUM = cumsum(SHARE), RANK = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

n_to_reach <- function(cum, thr) { i <- which(cum >= thr - 1e-9); if (length(i)) i[1] else length(cum) }

conc_summary <- conc %>%
  group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW) %>%
  summarise(
    TOTAL    = sum(VALUE),
    PARTNERS = n(),
    N_THR    = n_to_reach(CUM, params$threshold),
    TOP1     = first(PARTNER),
    TOP1_SH  = first(SHARE),
    TOP3_SH  = sum(head(SHARE, 3)),
    HHI      = sum(SHARE^2),                      # Herfindahl index: 1 = a single partner
    COUNTRIES = paste(head(PARTNER_CODE, N_THR), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(select(products, PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_NAME), by = "PRODUCT_CODE") %>%
  mutate(PRODUCT_NAME = if_else(PRODUCT_CODE == "TOTAL", "All products", PRODUCT_NAME),
         LABEL = paste0(PRODUCT_CODE, " · ", PRODUCT_NAME))
```

```{r helpers}
fmt_eur <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(x)        ~ "–",
    abs(x) >= 1e9   ~ sprintf("%.2f bn €", x / 1e9),
    abs(x) >= 1e6   ~ sprintf("%.1f M€", x / 1e6),
    abs(x) >= 1e3   ~ sprintf("%.0f k€", x / 1e3),
    TRUE            ~ sprintf("%.0f €", x)
  )
}
fmt_pct <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "–", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x))
key_of  <- function(product, flow) paste(product, flow, sep = KEY_SEP)

theme_plotly <- function(p) {
  p %>%
    layout(
      font          = list(family = FONT_FAMILY, color = COL_NAVY),
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      plot_bgcolor  = "#FFFFFF",
      hoverlabel    = list(font = list(family = FONT_FAMILY))
    ) %>%
    config(displaylogo = FALSE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c("lasso2d", "select2d"),
           topojsonURL = if (nzchar(params$topojson_url)) params$topojson_url else NULL)
}
axis_style <- list(gridcolor = "#DDEFF8", zerolinecolor = "#C9C4EC", linecolor = COL_NAVY)

# Wraps a plotly widget so the sidebar can switch the visible trace:
#   data-keys = key of each trace (same order as the traces), data-keyby = "flow" | "product"
keyed <- function(p, keys, keyby, height) {
  p$height <- height
  div(class = "keyed", `data-keys` = toJSON(keys), `data-keyby` = keyby, p)
}

kpi <- function(id, label, note = "") {
  div(class = "kpi", div(class = "kpi-value", id = paste0("kpi-", id), "–"),
      div(class = "kpi-label", label), div(class = "kpi-note", id = paste0("kpi-", id, "-note"), note))
}
```

```{r kpis}
# One entry per (product, flow) -> updated by the sidebar
kpi_tbl <- by_partner %>%
  group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW) %>%
  arrange(desc(VALUE), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarise(
    total     = sum(VALUE),
    partners  = n(),
    top1      = first(PARTNER),
    top1_sh   = first(VALUE) / sum(VALUE),
    top5_sh   = sum(head(VALUE, 5)) / sum(VALUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

balance_tbl <- flow_totals %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = FLOW, values_from = TOTAL, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(balance = EXPORT - IMPORT, cover = if_else(IMPORT > 0, EXPORT / IMPORT, NA_real_))

kpi_json <- kpi_tbl %>%
  left_join(balance_tbl, by = "PRODUCT_CODE") %>%
  mutate(
    key       = key_of(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW),
    total_f   = fmt_eur(total),
    top1_f    = top1,
    top1_note = paste0(fmt_pct(top1_sh), " of the flow"),
    top5_f    = fmt_pct(top5_sh),
    balance_f = paste0(if_else(balance >= 0, "+", "−"), fmt_eur(abs(balance))),
    balance_note = if_else(is.na(cover), "", sprintf("exports / imports = %.2f", cover))
  ) %>%
  select(key, total_f, partners, top1_f, top1_note, top5_f, balance_f, balance_note) %>%
  split(.$key) %>%
  map(~ as.list(.x[1, -1]))
```

```{r widgets}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. WORLD MAP - one choropleth trace per (product, flow); colour = log10(value), same scale
#    for every selection so colours stay comparable when the user switches product or flow.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
map_data <- by_partner %>%
  filter(!is.na(ISO3)) %>%
  left_join(flow_totals, by = c("PRODUCT_CODE", "FLOW")) %>%
  mutate(Z = log10(VALUE), SHARE = VALUE / TOTAL,
         HOVER = sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%s: %s<br>Share of the flow: %s", PARTNER, FLOW_LABELS[FLOW], fmt_eur(VALUE), fmt_pct(SHARE)))

z_rng <- c(3, ceiling(max(map_data$Z)))                       # 1 k€ -> max
cb_ticks <- seq(z_rng[1], z_rng[2], by = 1)
cb_text  <- fmt_eur(10^cb_ticks)

map_keys <- character(0)
p_map <- plot_geo()
for (pk in product_keys) for (fl in names(FLOW_COLORS)) {
  d <- filter(map_data, PRODUCT_CODE == pk, FLOW == fl)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) next
  map_keys <- c(map_keys, key_of(pk, fl))
  p_map <- p_map %>% add_trace(
    type = "choropleth", data = d,
    customdata = ~PARTNER_CODE,                          # partner code sent to crosstalk on click
    locations = ~ISO3, z = ~Z, text = ~HOVER, hoverinfo = "text",
    colorscale = SEQ_SCALE, zmin = z_rng[1], zmax = z_rng[2],
    marker = list(line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 0.5)),
    colorbar = list(title = list(text = "Value (log scale)", font = list(size = 11)),
                    tickvals = cb_ticks, ticktext = cb_text, len = 0.7, thickness = 12,
                    outlinewidth = 0, x = 1.0),
    visible = (pk == "TOTAL" && fl == "IMPORT")
  )
}

               showcountries = TRUE, countrycolor = "#DDEFF8", landcolor = "#F4F6FA",
               showocean = TRUE, oceancolor = "#FFFFFF", bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
               lataxis = list(range = c(-58, 85))),

  add_trace(

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ts_data <- trade_all %>%
  filter(PRODUCT_CODE != "TOTAL") %>%
  group_by(PARTNER_CODE, PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW, TIME) %>%
  summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop")
ts_total <- if (has_total) {
  trade_all %>% filter(PRODUCT_CODE == "TOTAL") %>%
    group_by(PARTNER_CODE, FLOW, TIME) %>% summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop")

  summarise(y = list(TIME), v = list(VALUE), .groups = "drop")

partner_names <- trade_all %>% distinct(PARTNER_CODE, PARTNER) %>% arrange(PARTNER_CODE)

# ---- Geographical aggregates (code_agg.xlsx) --------------------------------------------------
# Member countries are read from "Note (EN only)": the codes after ":" ("BE, BG, ... SM and MC"),
# or a formula "= Contenu de EUR - EU27_2020 - EFTA - UK - CC9_23" (base aggregate minus others).
# Codes are matched to the partner codes of the data, with the Eurostat aliases (RS -> XS, ME -> XM...).
CODE_ALIAS <- c(RS = "XS", XS = "RS", ME = "XM", XM = "ME", GR = "EL", EL = "GR", GB = "UK", UK = "GB")
to_data_code <- function(codes) {
  out <- ifelse(codes %in% partner_names$PARTNER_CODE, codes,
                ifelse(CODE_ALIAS[codes] %in% partner_names$PARTNER_CODE, CODE_ALIAS[codes], NA_character_))
  unique(na.omit(unname(out)))
}
parse_codes <- function(note) {
  if (is.na(note) || !str_detect(note, ":")) return(character(0))
  str_remove(note, "^[^:]*:") %>% str_replace_all("\\band\\b", ",") %>% str_split(",") %>% unlist() %>%
    str_trim() %>% str_remove_all("[\\.;]") %>% keep(~ str_detect(.x, "^[A-Z]{2}$"))
}

aggregates <- tibble(CODE = character(0), NAME = character(0), MEMBERS = list())
agg_status <- if (!nzchar(params$agg_path)) "no aggregate file set (params$agg_path)" else
  if (!file.exists(params$agg_path)) sprintf("aggregate file not found: %s (working directory: %s)", params$agg_path, getwd()) else "ok"
if (agg_status != "ok") warning("Regions unavailable: ", agg_status)
if (agg_status == "ok") {
  agg_raw <- read_excel(params$agg_path, col_types = "text")
  col_of <- function(motif) { nm <- names(agg_raw)[str_detect(tolower(names(agg_raw)), motif)][1]; if (is.na(nm)) stop("code_agg: column not found: ", motif); nm }
  agg_raw <- agg_raw %>% transmute(CODE = str_trim(.data[[col_of("^code$")]]), NAME = str_trim(.data[[col_of("^label")]]),
                                   NOTE = .data[[col_of("^note")]]) %>% filter(!is.na(CODE), CODE != "")
  members <- setNames(lapply(agg_raw$NOTE, function(n) to_data_code(parse_codes(n))), agg_raw$CODE)
  find_agg <- function(code) {              # "EU27_2020" -> "EU27" when the file uses the short code
    cand <- c(code, str_remove(code, "_\\d{4}$"), names(members)[startsWith(code, names(members))])
    cand <- cand[cand %in% names(members)]
    if (length(cand)) cand[1] else NA_character_
  }
  # formulas: "= Contenu de EUR - EU27_2020 - EFTA - UK - CC9_23"
  for (i in which(str_detect(agg_raw$NOTE, "^\\s*="))) {
    terms <- agg_raw$NOTE[i] %>% str_remove("^\\s*=") %>% str_remove("(?i)contenu de") %>% str_split("-") %>% unlist() %>% str_trim()
    terms <- terms[terms != ""]
    resolve <- function(t) { a <- find_agg(t); if (!is.na(a)) members[[a]] else to_data_code(t) }
    set <- resolve(terms[1])
    for (t in terms[-1]) set <- setdiff(set, resolve(t))
    members[[agg_raw$CODE[i]]] <- set
  }
  aggregates <- tibble(CODE = agg_raw$CODE, NAME = agg_raw$NAME, MEMBERS = unname(members)) %>%
    filter(lengths(MEMBERS) > 0)
}
# "All countries" = Eurostat's own WORLD aggregate when final_df has it, otherwise the sum of the
# partner countries. Offered first in the Country / region list under the code WORLD.
world_rows <- raw_all %>% filter(PARTNER_CODE == "WORLD")

} else {
  bind_rows(ts_data, mutate(ts_total, PRODUCT_CODE = "TOTAL")) %>%
    group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW, TIME) %>% summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop")
}
if (has_world && !has_total && !"TOTAL" %in% ts_world$PRODUCT_CODE) {
  ts_world <- bind_rows(ts_world, ts_world %>% group_by(FLOW, TIME) %>% summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(PRODUCT_CODE = "TOTAL"))
}
world_name <- if (has_world) "All countries" else "All countries (sum of partners)"
aggregates <- bind_rows(
  tibble(CODE = "WORLD", NAME = world_name, MEMBERS = list(partner_names$PARTNER_CODE)),
  aggregates)
agg_codes <- aggregates$CODE

# Denominators of the Country tab shares: WORLD for params$year (fallback: sum of the countries)

# Yearly series of the aggregates = sum of their members (added to TRADE_TS under the aggregate code)
if (nrow(aggregates) > 0) {
  ts_base <- bind_rows(ts_data, mutate(ts_total, PRODUCT_CODE = "TOTAL"))
  ts_agg <- map2(aggregates$CODE, aggregates$MEMBERS, function(code, mem) {

      group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW, TIME) %>% summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(PARTNER_CODE = code)

  ts_json <- bind_rows(ts_json,
    ts_agg %>% filter(VALUE > 0) %>% arrange(PARTNER_CODE, PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW, TIME) %>%
      group_by(k = paste(PARTNER_CODE, PRODUCT_CODE, FLOW, sep = KEY_SEP)) %>%
      summarise(y = list(TIME), v = list(VALUE), .groups = "drop"))
}

placeholder_hbars <- function(color, xtitle = "") {
  plot_ly() %>%
    add_trace(type = "bar", x = list(), y = list(), orientation = "h", text = list(), textposition = "outside",
             textfont = list(size = 10, color = COL_NAVY), cliponaxis = FALSE, hovertext = list(), hoverinfo = "text",

    layout(xaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = xtitle, tickformat = "~s", ticksuffix = "€")),
           yaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "", categoryorder = "trace", automargin = TRUE, tickfont = list(size = 10))),
           bargap = 0.25, margin = list(l = 10, r = 50, t = 10, b = 40)) %>%
    theme_plotly()
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1c. SANKEY - origins -> Luxembourg -> destinations for the selected product (one trace per product).
#     Left = where the imports come from, right = where the exports go; width = value.
#     Hovering a node highlights its links (native plotly behaviour).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
rgba <- function(hex, a) { r <- col2rgb(hex); sprintf("rgba(%d,%d,%d,%.2f)", r[1], r[2], r[3], a) }

sankey_side <- function(d, other_lbl) {
  d <- arrange(d, desc(VALUE))
  if (nrow(d) > SANKEY_N) {
    d <- bind_rows(head(d, SANKEY_N),
                   tibble(PARTNER = other_lbl, VALUE = sum(d$VALUE[-(1:SANKEY_N)])))
  }
  d
}

p_sankey <- plot_ly()
sankey_keys <- character(0)
for (pk in product_keys) {
  imp <- by_partner %>% filter(PRODUCT_CODE == pk, FLOW == "IMPORT") %>% select(PARTNER, VALUE) %>%
    sankey_side(sprintf("Other origins"))
  exp <- by_partner %>% filter(PRODUCT_CODE == pk, FLOW == "EXPORT") %>% select(PARTNER, VALUE) %>%
    sankey_side(sprintf("Other destinations"))
  if (nrow(imp) + nrow(exp) == 0) next
  sankey_keys <- c(sankey_keys, pk)

  nodes <- c(imp$PARTNER, params$reporter, exp$PARTNER)
  i_lu  <- nrow(imp)                                             # 0-based index of the centre node
  src   <- c(seq_len(nrow(imp)) - 1, rep(i_lu, nrow(exp)))
  tgt   <- c(rep(i_lu, nrow(imp)), i_lu + seq_len(nrow(exp)))
  val   <- c(imp$VALUE, exp$VALUE)
  link_flow <- c(rep("IMPORT", nrow(imp)), rep("EXPORT", nrow(exp)))
  link_lbl  <- c(sprintf("%s → %s<br>Imports: %s (%s of imports)", imp$PARTNER, params$reporter, fmt_eur(imp$VALUE), fmt_pct(imp$VALUE / sum(imp$VALUE))),
                 sprintf("%s → %s<br>Exports: %s (%s of exports)", params$reporter, exp$PARTNER, fmt_eur(exp$VALUE), fmt_pct(exp$VALUE / sum(exp$VALUE))))
  node_lbl  <- c(sprintf("%s<br>Imports: %s", imp$PARTNER, fmt_eur(imp$VALUE)),
                 sprintf("%s<br>Imports: %s · Exports: %s", params$reporter, fmt_eur(sum(imp$VALUE)), fmt_eur(sum(exp$VALUE))),
                 sprintf("%s<br>Exports: %s", exp$PARTNER, fmt_eur(exp$VALUE)))
  node_col  <- c(rep(FLOW_COLORS[["IMPORT"]], nrow(imp)), COL_NAVY, rep(FLOW_COLORS[["EXPORT"]], nrow(exp)))
  node_x    <- c(rep(0.01, nrow(imp)), 0.5, rep(0.99, nrow(exp)))

  p_sankey <- p_sankey %>% add_trace(
    type = "sankey", arrangement = "snap", orientation = "h",
    node = list(label = nodes, color = node_col, pad = 10, thickness = 16,
                line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1),
                customdata = node_lbl, hovertemplate = "%{customdata}<extra></extra>"),
    link = list(source = src, target = tgt, value = val,
                color = ifelse(link_flow == "IMPORT", rgba(FLOW_COLORS[["IMPORT"]], 0.35), rgba(FLOW_COLORS[["EXPORT"]], 0.35)),
                customdata = link_lbl, hovertemplate = "%{customdata}<extra></extra>"),
    textfont = list(family = FONT_FAMILY, size = 11, color = COL_NAVY),
    visible = (pk == "TOTAL")
  )
}
p_sankey <- p_sankey %>% layout(margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 10, b = 10)) %>% theme_plotly()

         COLOR = if_else(BALANCE >= 0, FLOW_COLORS[["EXPORT"]], FLOW_COLORS[["IMPORT"]]))

  group_by(FLOW, PARTNER) %>% mutate(SHARE = VALUE / sum(VALUE), PTOT = sum(VALUE)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(products, by = "PRODUCT_CODE") %>%
  mutate(HOVER = sprintf("<b>%s</b> · %s %s<br>%s<br>%s of the partner's %s", PARTNER, PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_NAME,
                         fmt_eur(VALUE), fmt_pct(SHARE), tolower(FLOW_LABELS[FLOW])))

  grid <- d %>% select(PARTNER, PRODUCT_CODE, SHARE, HOVER) %>%
    complete(PARTNER = order_p, PRODUCT_CODE = products$PRODUCT_CODE) %>%
    mutate(PARTNER = factor(PARTNER, levels = order_p)) %>% arrange(PARTNER, PRODUCT_CODE)
  zmat <- matrix(grid$SHARE, nrow = length(order_p), byrow = TRUE)
  hmat <- matrix(replace_na(grid$HOVER, ""), nrow = length(order_p), byrow = TRUE)
  p_heat <- p_heat %>% add_trace(
    type = "heatmap", x = products$PRODUCT_CODE, y = order_p, z = zmat,
    text = hmat, hoverinfo = "text",
    colorscale = SEQ_SCALE, zmin = 0, zmax = heat_cap, xgap = 1, ygap = 1,
    colorbar = list(title = list(text = sprintf("Share<br>(≥ %.0f%% = darkest)", 100 * heat_cap), font = list(size = 11)),
                    tickformat = ".0%", len = 0.8, thickness = 12, outlinewidth = 0),
    visible = (fl == "IMPORT")
  )
}

    type = "scatter", mode = "markers", data = d, x = ~TOTAL, y = ~N_THR, text = ~PRODUCT_CODE,

    hovertext = ~sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%s: %s<br>%d partner(s) reach %.0f%% · HHI %.2f", LABEL, FLOW_LABELS[fl], fmt_eur(TOTAL), N_THR, 100 * params$threshold, HHI),
    hoverinfo = "text", visible = (fl == "IMPORT"), showlegend = FALSE
  )
}
p_conc_sc <- p_conc_sc %>%
  layout(

# 7e. country tab table: chapters traded with the selected entity (rows replaced by the page)

# 7d. table: one row per chapter and flow; the flow column is hidden and used as a filter by the page
conc_table <- conc_chapters %>%
```

```{r summary}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SUMMARY TAB - key figures of params$year (WORLD aggregate when available), top 5 chapters by
# flow, Balance trade of goods, the neighbouring countries and the history of their top 5 chapters.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
NB        <- unlist(params$neighbours)
EXCL_PROD <- c("TOTAL", unlist(params$excluded_products))
yr        <- params$year

# World by product x flow x year (Eurostat WORLD, or the sum of the partner countries)
world_py <- ts_world %>% rename(VALUE_W = VALUE)
world_year <- world_py %>% filter(TIME == yr)
w_tot <- function(fl) { v <- world_year$VALUE_W[world_year$PRODUCT_CODE == "TOTAL" & world_year$FLOW == fl]; if (length(v)) v[1] else NA_real_ }
imp_w <- w_tot("IMPORT"); exp_w <- w_tot("EXPORT"); bal_w <- exp_w - imp_w

# Evolution of the totals (all years)
world_tot_ts <- world_py %>% filter(PRODUCT_CODE == "TOTAL") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = FLOW, values_from = VALUE_W, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(BALANCE = EXPORT - IMPORT) %>% arrange(TIME)

# Top 5 chapters of params$year by flow (TOTAL and excluded chapters left out)
top5 <- world_year %>%
  filter(!PRODUCT_CODE %in% EXCL_PROD) %>%
  group_by(FLOW) %>% mutate(SHARE = VALUE_W / sum(VALUE_W)) %>%
  slice_max(VALUE_W, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(select(products, PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_NAME), by = "PRODUCT_CODE") %>%
  mutate(LABEL = paste0(PRODUCT_CODE, " · ", if_else(nchar(PRODUCT_NAME) > 40, paste0(str_sub(PRODUCT_NAME, 1, 38), "…"), PRODUCT_NAME)))

p_top5 <- function(fl) {
  d <- top5 %>% filter(FLOW == fl) %>% arrange(VALUE_W)
  plot_ly(d, x = ~VALUE_W, y = ~LABEL, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = FLOW_COLORS[[fl]], line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1)),
          text = ~fmt_pct(SHARE), textposition = "outside", textfont = list(size = 11, color = COL_NAVY), cliponaxis = FALSE,
          hovertext = ~sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%s: %s · %s of %s", LABEL, FLOW_LABELS[fl], fmt_eur(VALUE_W), fmt_pct(SHARE), tolower(FLOW_LABELS[fl])),
          hoverinfo = "text") %>%
    layout(xaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "", tickformat = "~s", ticksuffix = "€")),
           yaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "", categoryorder = "trace", automargin = TRUE, tickfont = list(size = 11))),
           bargap = 0.3, margin = list(l = 10, r = 50, t = 10, b = 30)) %>%
    theme_plotly()
}

bal_prod <- world_year %>% filter(!PRODUCT_CODE %in% EXCL_PROD) %>%

# History: top 5 chapters per year, neighbours summed (animation + rank chart)
nb_hist <- ts_data %>%
  filter(PARTNER_CODE %in% NB, !PRODUCT_CODE %in% EXCL_PROD) %>%
  group_by(TIME, FLOW, PRODUCT_CODE) %>% summarise(VALUE = sum(VALUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(TIME, FLOW) %>% mutate(SHARE = VALUE / sum(VALUE), RANK = rank(-VALUE, ties.method = "first")) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(select(products, PRODUCT_CODE, PRODUCT_NAME), by = "PRODUCT_CODE") %>%
  mutate(LABEL = paste0(PRODUCT_CODE, " · ", if_else(nchar(PRODUCT_NAME) > 34, paste0(str_sub(PRODUCT_NAME, 1, 32), "…"), PRODUCT_NAME)))
nb_top5 <- nb_hist %>% filter(RANK <= 5)

p_anim <- function(fl) {
  d <- nb_top5 %>% filter(FLOW == fl) %>% arrange(TIME, RANK) %>%
    mutate(TEXT = sprintf("%s · %s", fmt_eur(VALUE), fmt_pct(SHARE)),
           HOVER = sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%d · rank %d<br>%s: %s · %s of the flow", LABEL, TIME, RANK, FLOW_LABELS[fl], fmt_eur(VALUE), fmt_pct(SHARE)))
  xmax <- max(d$VALUE) * 1.25
  plot_ly(d, x = ~VALUE, y = ~LABEL, frame = ~TIME, ids = ~PRODUCT_CODE, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
          marker = list(color = FLOW_COLORS[[fl]], line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1)),
          text = ~TEXT, textposition = "outside", textfont = list(size = 10, color = COL_NAVY), cliponaxis = FALSE,
          hovertext = ~HOVER, hoverinfo = "text") %>%
    layout(xaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "", tickformat = "~s", ticksuffix = "€", range = c(0, xmax))),
           yaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "", categoryorder = "total ascending", automargin = TRUE, tickfont = list(size = 11))),
           bargap = 0.3, margin = list(l = 10, r = 90, t = 10, b = 70)) %>%
    animation_opts(frame = 1500, transition = 600, easing = "cubic-in-out", redraw = TRUE) %>%
    animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Year ", font = list(color = COL_NAVY, size = 14)), font = list(size = 10)) %>%
    animation_button(label = "▶ Play", x = 0, xanchor = "left", y = -0.35, yanchor = "top") %>%
    theme_plotly()
}

# Rank grid: rows = every chapter that reached the top 5 at least once, columns = years,
# cell = rank that year (dark = rank 1, light = rank 5, blank = outside the top 5)
RANK_SCALE <- list(c(0, "#271D67"), c(0.25, "#0E6FA6"), c(0.5, "#1AADE7"), c(0.75, "#8ED2F0"), c(1, "#D3EDF9"))
p_rank <- function(fl) {
  d <- nb_hist %>% filter(FLOW == fl)
  rows <- d %>% filter(RANK <= 5) %>% group_by(PRODUCT_CODE, LABEL) %>%
    summarise(N_TOP = n(), MEAN_RANK = mean(RANK), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(N_TOP), MEAN_RANK)
  yrs <- sort(unique(d$TIME))
  g <- d %>% filter(PRODUCT_CODE %in% rows$PRODUCT_CODE) %>%
    select(PRODUCT_CODE, TIME, RANK, VALUE, SHARE, LABEL) %>%
    complete(PRODUCT_CODE = rows$PRODUCT_CODE, TIME = yrs) %>%
    mutate(Z = if_else(!is.na(RANK) & RANK <= 5, as.numeric(RANK), NA_real_),
           TXT = if_else(is.na(Z), "", as.character(RANK)),
           HOVER = if_else(is.na(RANK), "", sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%d · rank %d<br>%s · %s of the %s", LABEL, TIME, RANK, fmt_eur(VALUE), fmt_pct(SHARE), tolower(FLOW_LABELS[fl])))) %>%
    mutate(PRODUCT_CODE = factor(PRODUCT_CODE, levels = rows$PRODUCT_CODE)) %>% arrange(PRODUCT_CODE, TIME)
  n_r <- nrow(rows); n_c <- length(yrs)
  zmat <- matrix(g$Z, nrow = n_r, byrow = TRUE); tmat <- matrix(g$TXT, nrow = n_r, byrow = TRUE); hmat <- matrix(g$HOVER, nrow = n_r, byrow = TRUE)
  row_lbl <- sprintf("%s  (%d yr%s)", rows$LABEL, rows$N_TOP, if_else(rows$N_TOP > 1, "s", ""))
  # rank numbers as annotations: white on the dark cells (ranks 1-3), navy on the light ones (4-5)
  lab <- g %>% filter(!is.na(Z)) %>%
    mutate(Y = row_lbl[as.integer(PRODUCT_CODE)], COL = if_else(Z <= 3, "#FFFFFF", COL_NAVY))
  ann <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(lab)), function(i)
    list(x = lab$TIME[i], y = lab$Y[i], text = lab$TXT[i], showarrow = FALSE,
         font = list(size = 11, color = lab$COL[i], family = FONT_FAMILY), xref = "x", yref = "y"))
  plot_ly() %>%
    add_trace(type = "heatmap", x = yrs, y = row_lbl, z = zmat,
              hovertext = hmat, hoverinfo = "text",
              colorscale = RANK_SCALE, zmin = 1, zmax = 5, xgap = 3, ygap = 3, showscale = TRUE,
              colorbar = list(title = list(text = "Rank", font = list(size = 11)), tickvals = 1:5, len = 0.6, thickness = 12, outlinewidth = 0)) %>%
    layout(xaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "", dtick = 1, tickangle = -45, tickfont = list(size = 10), showgrid = FALSE,
                                      range = c(min(yrs) - 0.5, max(yrs) + 0.5))),
           yaxis = c(axis_style, list(title = "", type = "category", autorange = "reversed", automargin = TRUE, tickfont = list(size = 11), showgrid = FALSE)),
           annotations = ann,
           margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 10, b = 60)) %>%
    theme_plotly()
}
rank_height <- function(fl) { n <- nb_hist %>% filter(FLOW == fl, RANK <= 5) %>% distinct(PRODUCT_CODE) %>% nrow(); max(260, 30 * n + 120) }

nb_names <- partner_names %>% filter(PARTNER_CODE %in% NB) %>% pull(PARTNER)
```

```{r cockpit}
legend_item <- function(col, lbl) div(span(class = "swatch", style = paste0("background:", col, ";")), lbl)

sidebar <- div(

    ),
    div(class = "hint", if (has_total) "All products = Eurostat TOTAL" else "All products = sum of the HS2 chapters")
  ),
  div(
    tags$label(class = "control-label", `for` = "country_select", "Country / region"),
    tags$select(
      id = "country_select", class = "form-select",
      tags$optgroup(label = "Regions",
        lapply(seq_len(nrow(aggregates)), function(i) tags$option(value = aggregates$CODE[i], paste0(aggregates$NAME[i], " [", aggregates$CODE[i], "]")))),
      tags$optgroup(label = "Countries",
        lapply(order(partner_names$PARTNER), function(i)

                      paste0(partner_names$PARTNER, " [", partner_names$PARTNER_CODE, "]")[i])))
    ),
    div(class = "hint", if (nrow(aggregates) > 1) sprintf("Country view · all countries (WORLD), %d regions or one country · a country is also set by clicking the map", nrow(aggregates) - 1)
                        else paste0("Regions unavailable: ", agg_status))
  ),
  div(
    tags$label(class = "control-label", `for` = "thr_range", "Concentration threshold"),
    div(class = "range-value", id = "thr_value", sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * params$threshold)),
    tags$input(type = "range", id = "thr_range", min = 50, max = 100, step = 1, value = round(100 * params$threshold)),
    div(class = "hint", "Product view: cumulative share of the flow the top partners must reach")
  ),
  div(
    class = "side-legend",
    div(class = "control-label", "Legend"),
    legend_item(FLOW_COLORS[["IMPORT"]], "Imports (into Luxembourg)"),
    legend_item(FLOW_COLORS[["EXPORT"]], "Exports (from Luxembourg)"),
    div("Map and heatmap: darker = larger value / share")
  ),
  div(
    class = "side-footer",
    sprintf("%d partner countries · %d HS2 chapters · generated %s", n_distinct(trade$PARTNER_CODE), nrow(products), format(Sys.Date(), "%d/%m/%Y")),
    tags$details(
      tags$summary(sprintf("%d non-country codes excluded", nrow(excluded_codes))),
      lapply(seq_len(nrow(excluded_codes)), function(i)
        div(tags$code(excluded_codes$PARTNER_CODE[i]), " ", excluded_codes$PARTNER_LABEL[i]))
    )
  )
)

kpi_static <- function(value, label, note = "") {
  div(class = "kpi", div(class = "kpi-value", value), div(class = "kpi-label", label), div(class = "kpi-note", note))
}
with_h <- function(p, h) { p$height <- h; p }
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Plotly sizes the legend with the font available when the chart is drawn. Poppins is loaded
// from Google Fonts afterwards -> redraw once the fonts are ready.
(function () {
  function redraw() {
    if (!window.Plotly) return;
    document.querySelectorAll('.js-plotly-plot').forEach(function (gd) {
      try { Plotly.relayout(gd, { 'font.family': gd._fullLayout.font.family }); } catch (e) {}
    });
  }
  function schedule() { setTimeout(redraw, 150); }
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(schedule);
  window.addEventListener('load', schedule);
})();

// Cockpit: the sidebar (flow pills + product select) switches the visible trace of every widget.
// Each widget wrapper carries data-keys (one key per trace) and data-keyby:
//   "flow"     -> key = product || flow
//   "product"  -> key = product
//   "flowonly" -> key = flow
(function () {
  var SEP = '||';

  function selection() {
    var f = document.querySelector('#flow_pills input:checked');
    var p = document.getElementById('product_select');
    return { flow: f ? f.value : 'IMPORT', product: p ? p.value : 'TOTAL' };
  }

  function keyFor(keyby, sel) {
    if (keyby === 'product')  return sel.product;
    if (keyby === 'flowonly') return sel.flow;
    return sel.product + SEP + sel.flow;
  }

  function setText(id, txt) { var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = txt; }

  // ---- Annual evolution: partner from the crosstalk selection (click on the map) ------------
  var TS = {};
  (window.TRADE_TS || []).forEach(function (r) { TS[r.k] = r; });
  var selectedPartner = window.TRADE_EVO_DEFAULT || null;

  function updateEvolution(sel) {
    sel = sel || selection();
    var wrap = document.getElementById('evo-wrap');
    var gd = wrap && wrap.querySelector('.js-plotly-plot');
    if (!gd || !window.Plotly || !gd.data) return;
    var pname = (window.TRADE_PRODUCTS || {})[sel.product] || sel.product;
    var pn = selectedPartner ? ((window.TRADE_PARTNERS || {})[selectedPartner] || selectedPartner) : '–';
    setText('evo-partner', pn + ' · ' + pname);
    var xs = [], ys = [];
    ['IMPORT', 'EXPORT'].forEach(function (f) {
      var r = selectedPartner ? TS[selectedPartner + SEP + sel.product + SEP + f] : null;
      xs.push(r ? r.y : []); ys.push(r ? r.v : []);
    });
    var names = ['IMPORT', 'EXPORT'].map(function (f) { return (window.TRADE_FLOWS || {})[f] || f; });
    try { Plotly.restyle(gd, { x: xs, y: ys, name: names }, [0, 1]); } catch (e) {}
  }

  // ---- Product tab: partner concentration ---------------------------------------------------
  var CONC = {};
  (window.TRADE_CONC || []).forEach(function (r) { CONC[r.k] = r; });
  var PRODUCT_CODES = Object.keys(window.TRADE_PRODUCTS || {}).filter(function (k) { return k !== 'TOTAL'; });

  function threshold() {
    var el = document.getElementById('thr_range');
    return el ? Number(el.value) / 100 : (window.TRADE_THRESHOLD || 0.9);
  }
  function nToReach(cum, thr) {
    for (var i = 0; i < cum.length; i++) if (cum[i] >= thr - 1e-9) return i + 1;
    return cum.length;
  }
  function fmtEur(x) {
    if (x >= 1e9) return (x / 1e9).toFixed(2) + ' bn €';
    if (x >= 1e6) return (x / 1e6).toFixed(1) + ' M€';
    if (x >= 1e3) return (x / 1e3).toFixed(0) + ' k€';
    return x.toFixed(0) + ' €';
  }
  function plotIn(id) { var w = document.getElementById(id); return w && w.querySelector('.js-plotly-plot'); }

  function updateConcentration(sel) {
    sel = sel || selection();
    var thr = threshold(), fname = (window.TRADE_FLOWS || {})[sel.flow] || sel.flow;
    var pct = Math.round(thr * 100) + '%';
    setText('thr_value', pct);
    setText('conc-title', 'Partner concentration · ' + fname + ' · ' + pct);
    setText('conc-sub', 'How many partner countries, taken from the largest, are needed to reach ' + pct + ' of each HS2 chapter\'s ' + fname.toLowerCase());

    // per chapter: partners needed at this threshold
    var rows = [];
    PRODUCT_CODES.forEach(function (p) {
      var r = CONC[p + SEP + sel.flow]; if (!r) return;
      var n = nToReach(r.cum, thr), top1 = r.cum[0] || 0;
      rows.push({ p: p, label: p + ' · ' + (window.TRADE_PRODUCTS[p] || p), n: n, total: r.total,
                  partners: r.codes.length, top1: top1, topCode: r.codes[0],
                  list: r.codes.slice(0, n).join(', ') });
    });

    // KPIs
    var ns = rows.map(function (r) { return r.n; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
    var median = ns.length ? (ns.length % 2 ? ns[(ns.length - 1) / 2] : (ns[ns.length / 2 - 1] + ns[ns.length / 2]) / 2) : null;
    setText('kpi-conc-median', median == null ? '–' : String(median));
    setText('kpi-conc-range',  ns.length ? ns[0] + ' – ' + ns[ns.length - 1] : '–');
    setText('kpi-conc-few',    String(rows.filter(function (r) { return r.n <= 3; }).length));
    setText('kpi-conc-few-note', 'of ' + rows.length + ' chapters reach ' + pct + ' with 3 partners or fewer');
    setText('kpi-conc-top1',   String(rows.filter(function (r) { return r.top1 >= 0.5; }).length));

    // Bars: sorted so that the most concentrated chapter is on top (plotly draws bottom-up)
    var sorted = rows.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return (b.n - a.n) || (b.total - a.total); });
    var ti = sel.flow === 'IMPORT' ? 0 : 1;
    var gdb = plotIn('bar-wrap');
    if (gdb && gdb.data) {
      try {
        Plotly.restyle(gdb, {
          x: [sorted.map(function (r) { return r.n; })], y: [sorted.map(function (r) { return r.label; })],
          text: [sorted.map(function (r) { return r.n; })],
          hovertext: [sorted.map(function (r) {
            return '<b>' + r.label + '</b><br>' + fname + ': ' + fmtEur(r.total) + ' · ' + r.partners + ' partners<br>' +
                   r.n + ' partner(s) reach ' + pct + '<br>Top partner: ' + ((window.TRADE_PARTNERS || {})[r.topCode] || r.topCode) +
                   ' (' + (100 * r.top1).toFixed(1) + '%)'; })]
        }, [ti]);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    // Scatter
    var gds = plotIn('sc-wrap');
    if (gds && gds.data) {
      var byP = {}; rows.forEach(function (r) { byP[r.p] = r; });
      var xs = gds.data[ti].text, ys = [], ht = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {
        var r = byP[xs[i]]; ys.push(r ? r.n : null);
        ht.push(r ? ('<b>' + r.label + '</b><br>' + fname + ': ' + fmtEur(r.total) + '<br>' + r.n + ' partner(s) reach ' + pct) : '');
      }
      try { Plotly.restyle(gds, { y: [ys], hovertext: [ht] }, [ti]); } catch (e) {}
    }
    // Cumulative curve of the selected product
    var gdc = plotIn('curve-wrap');
    var rc = CONC[sel.product + SEP + sel.flow];
    var pname = (window.TRADE_PRODUCTS || {})[sel.product] || sel.product;
    setText('curve-title', pname + ' · ' + fname);
    if (gdc && gdc.data) {
      var n = rc ? nToReach(rc.cum, thr) : 0;
      var ranks = rc ? rc.cum.map(function (_, i) { return i + 1; }) : [];
      var names = rc ? rc.codes.map(function (c) { return (window.TRADE_PARTNERS || {})[c] || c; }) : [];
      // labels of the partners inside the threshold (full names up to 8 partners, codes beyond)
      var inRanks = ranks.slice(0, n), inCum = rc ? rc.cum.slice(0, n) : [];
      var inLab = rc ? rc.codes.slice(0, n).map(function (c, i) { return n <= 8 ? names[i] : (n <= 20 ? c : ''); }) : [];
      var flowCol = sel.flow === 'IMPORT' ? '#0E8FC2' : '#D97A06';
      try {
        Plotly.restyle(gdc, { x: [ranks, rc ? [n] : [], inRanks], y: [rc ? rc.cum : [], rc ? [rc.cum[n - 1]] : [], inCum],
                              customdata: [names, [], []], text: [[], [], inLab],
                              'marker.color': [gdc.data[0].marker.color, '#D7263D', flowCol] }, [0, 1, 2]);
        var xmax = rc ? Math.min(rc.codes.length, Math.max(15, 2 * n + 5)) : 10;
        Plotly.relayout(gdc, { 'shapes[0].y0': thr, 'shapes[0].y1': thr, 'xaxis.range': [0, xmax + 0.5], 'xaxis.dtick': xmax > 30 ? 5 : 1,
                               'xaxis.title.text': rc ? (n + ' of ' + rc.codes.length + ' partners reach ' + pct) : 'Partners, ranked by value' });
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    // Table: show the current flow, refresh the threshold-dependent columns
    if (window.jQuery && jQuery.fn.dataTable) {
      var tbl = document.querySelector('#conc-table table');
      if (tbl && jQuery.fn.dataTable.isDataTable(tbl)) {
        var dt = jQuery(tbl).DataTable();
        var byCode = {}; rows.forEach(function (r) { byCode[r.p] = r; });
        dt.rows().every(function () {
          var d = this.data();
          if (d[0] !== sel.flow) return;
          var r = byCode[d[1]]; if (!r) return;
          if (d[5] !== r.n || d[9] !== r.list) { d[5] = r.n; d[9] = r.list; this.data(d); }
        });
        dt.column(0).search('^' + sel.flow + '$', true, false).draw(false);
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- Tabs: one panel at a time; widgets shown after being hidden are resized -------------
  function refreshWidgets(scope) {
    setTimeout(function () {
      if (window.Plotly) scope.querySelectorAll('.js-plotly-plot').forEach(function (gd) {
        if (gd.offsetParent !== null) { try { Plotly.Plots.resize(gd); } catch (e) {} }
      });
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
      if (window.jQuery && jQuery.fn.dataTable) {
        try { jQuery.fn.dataTable.tables({ visible: true, api: true }).columns.adjust(); } catch (e) {}
      }
    }, 60);
  }
  function applyTab() {
    var t = document.querySelector('#tab_pills input:checked');
    var want = t ? t.value : 'summary';
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(function (panel) {
      var active = panel.getAttribute('data-tab') === want;
      panel.classList.toggle('active', active);
      if (active) refreshWidgets(panel);
    });
  }

  function mapWidget() {
    var w = document.querySelector('.keyed'); return w && w.querySelector('.js-plotly-plot');
  }

  // Outline the selected country on the map (last trace of the map widget)
  function highlightOnMap(codes) {
    var gd = mapWidget(); if (!gd || !gd.data) return;
    codes = codes ? (Array.isArray(codes) ? codes : [codes]) : [];
    var iso = codes.map(function (c) { return (window.TRADE_ISO3 || {})[c]; }).filter(Boolean);
    try {
      Plotly.restyle(gd, { locations: [iso], z: [iso.map(function () { return 1; })] }, [gd.data.length - 1]);
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  // ---- Country tab ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  var AGG = window.TRADE_AGG || {};
  var COUNTRY_CODES = Object.keys(window.TRADE_PARTNERS || {});
  function isAgg(code) { return !!AGG[code]; }
  function entityName(code) { return isAgg(code) ? AGG[code].name : ((window.TRADE_PARTNERS || {})[code] || code); }
  function valAt(code, product, flow, year) {
    var r = TS[code + SEP + product + SEP + flow]; if (!r) return 0;
    var i = r.y.indexOf(year); return i >= 0 ? r.v[i] : 0;
  }
  function selectedCountry() { var el = document.getElementById('country_select'); return el ? el.value : null; }
  function pctTxt(x) { return (100 * x).toFixed(1) + '%'; }

  function updateCountry(sel) {
    sel = sel || selection();
    var code = selectedCountry(); if (!code) return;
    var year = window.TRADE_YEAR, thr = threshold(), pct = Math.round(thr * 100) + '%';
    var name = entityName(code), pname = (window.TRADE_PRODUCTS || {})[sel.product] || sel.product;
    var fname = (window.TRADE_FLOWS || {})[sel.flow] || sel.flow;
    var agg = isAgg(code);
    setText('cty-title', name + ' · ' + year);
    setText('cty-sub', code === 'WORLD' ? (window.TRADE_HAS_WORLD ? 'Eurostat WORLD aggregate of final_df (all partners, no filter)' : 'Sum of the ' + AGG[code].members.length + ' partner countries (no WORLD rows in final_df)') :
                       agg ? (AGG[code].members.length + ' member countries present in the data: ' + AGG[code].members.join(', ')) : ('Partner code ' + code));

    // KPIs (selected product)
    var imp = valAt(code, sel.product, 'IMPORT', year), exp = valAt(code, sel.product, 'EXPORT', year);
    var WT = window.TRADE_WORLDTOT || window.TRADE_FLOWTOT || {}, denom = window.TRADE_HAS_WORLD ? ' of WORLD ' : ' of ';
    var totI = WT[sel.product + SEP + 'IMPORT'] || 0, totE = WT[sel.product + SEP + 'EXPORT'] || 0;
    function rankOf(flow, v) { if (agg || !v) return null; var r = 1; COUNTRY_CODES.forEach(function (c) { if (c !== code && valAt(c, sel.product, flow, year) > v) r++; }); return r; }
    var rI = rankOf('IMPORT', imp), rE = rankOf('EXPORT', exp);
    setText('kpi-cty-imp', imp ? fmtEur(imp) : '–');
    setText('kpi-cty-imp-note', pname + (totI ? ' · ' + pctTxt(imp / totI) + denom + 'imports' : '') + (rI ? ' · rank ' + rI : ''));
    setText('kpi-cty-exp', exp ? fmtEur(exp) : '–');
    setText('kpi-cty-exp-note', pname + (totE ? ' · ' + pctTxt(exp / totE) + denom + 'exports' : '') + (rE ? ' · rank ' + rE : ''));
    var bal = exp - imp;
    setText('kpi-cty-bal', (bal >= 0 ? '+' : '−') + fmtEur(Math.abs(bal)));
    setText('kpi-cty-bal-note', imp ? 'exports / imports = ' + (exp / imp).toFixed(2) : '');
    setText('kpi-cty-share', (totI + totE) ? pctTxt((imp + exp) / (totI + totE)) : '–');
    setText('kpi-cty-share-note', pname + ' · imports + exports');

    // chapters traded with the partner (both flows) and their concentration for the selected flow
    var chapters = PRODUCT_CODES.map(function (p) { return { p: p, label: p + ' · ' + (window.TRADE_PRODUCTS[p] || p),
      imp: valAt(code, p, 'IMPORT', year), exp: valAt(code, p, 'EXPORT', year) }; }).filter(function (c) { return c.imp > 0 || c.exp > 0; });
    setText('kpi-cty-chap', String(chapters.length));
    setText('kpi-cty-chap-note', 'of ' + PRODUCT_CODES.length + ' with imports or exports');
    var fl = sel.flow === 'IMPORT' ? 'imp' : 'exp';
    var ranked = chapters.filter(function (c) { return c[fl] > 0; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b[fl] - a[fl]; });
    var tot = ranked.reduce(function (s, c) { return s + c[fl]; }, 0), cum = [], acc = 0;
    ranked.forEach(function (c) { acc += c[fl]; cum.push(acc / tot); });
    var n = cum.length ? nToReach(cum, thr) : 0;
    setText('kpi-cty-conc', cum.length ? String(n) : '–');
    setText('kpi-cty-conc-note', 'of ' + ranked.length + ' chapters reach ' + pct + ' of the ' + fname.toLowerCase());

    // annual evolution (selected product)
    setText('cty-evo-title', name + ' · ' + pname);
    var gde = plotIn('cty-evo-wrap');
    if (gde && gde.data) {
      var xs = [], ys = [];
      ['IMPORT', 'EXPORT'].forEach(function (f) { var r = TS[code + SEP + sel.product + SEP + f]; xs.push(r ? r.y : []); ys.push(r ? r.v : []); });
      try { Plotly.restyle(gde, { x: xs, y: ys, name: ['IMPORT', 'EXPORT'].map(function (f) { return (window.TRADE_FLOWS || {})[f] || f; }) }, [0, 1]); } catch (e) {}
    }
    // concentration curve over chapters
    setText('cty-curve-title', fname);
    var gdc = plotIn('cty-curve-wrap');
    if (gdc && gdc.data) {
      var ranks = cum.map(function (_, i) { return i + 1; }), labels = ranked.map(function (c) { return c.label; });
      var inLab = ranked.slice(0, n).map(function (c) { return n <= 8 ? c.p + ' ' + (window.TRADE_PRODUCTS[c.p] || '').slice(0, 18) : (n <= 20 ? c.p : ''); });
      var flowCol = sel.flow === 'IMPORT' ? '#0E8FC2' : '#D97A06';
      var xmax = Math.min(ranks.length, Math.max(15, 2 * n + 5));
      try {
        Plotly.restyle(gdc, { x: [ranks, n ? [n] : [], ranks.slice(0, n)], y: [cum, n ? [cum[n - 1]] : [], cum.slice(0, n)],
                              customdata: [labels, [], []], text: [[], [], inLab], 'marker.color': [gdc.data[0].marker.color, '#D7263D', flowCol] }, [0, 1, 2]);
        Plotly.relayout(gdc, { 'shapes[0].y0': thr, 'shapes[0].y1': thr, 'xaxis.range': [0, xmax + 0.5], 'xaxis.dtick': xmax > 30 ? 5 : 1,
                               'xaxis.title.text': cum.length ? (n + ' of ' + ranked.length + ' chapters reach ' + pct) : 'HS2 chapters, ranked by value' });
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    // top chapters imported from / exported to the partner
    function topChapters(key, wrapId, titleId, title) {
      var list = chapters.filter(function (c) { return c[key] > 0; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b[key] - a[key]; }).slice(0, 15).reverse();
      var total = chapters.reduce(function (s, c) { return s + c[key]; }, 0);
      setText(titleId, title + ' · ' + fmtEur(total));
      var gd = plotIn(wrapId); if (!gd || !gd.data) return;
      try {
        Plotly.restyle(gd, { x: [list.map(function (c) { return c[key]; })], y: [list.map(function (c) { return c.p + ' · ' + (window.TRADE_PRODUCTS[c.p] || '').slice(0, 32); })],
          text: [list.map(function (c) { return pctTxt(c[key] / total); })],
          hovertext: [list.map(function (c) { return '<b>' + c.label + '</b><br>' + fmtEur(c[key]) + ' · ' + pctTxt(c[key] / total); })] }, [0]);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    topChapters('imp', 'cty-imp-wrap', 'cty-imp-title', 'Top imported chapters from ' + name);
    topChapters('exp', 'cty-exp-wrap', 'cty-exp-title', 'Top exported chapters to ' + name);

    // member countries (aggregates only)
    var memCard = document.getElementById('cty-mem-card');
    if (memCard) memCard.style.display = agg ? '' : 'none';
    if (agg) {
      setText('cty-mem-title', name + ' · ' + fname + ' · ' + pname);
      var mem = AGG[code].members.map(function (c) { return { c: c, v: valAt(c, sel.product, sel.flow, year) }; })
        .filter(function (m) { return m.v > 0; }).sort(function (a, b) { return b.v - a.v; });
      var mtot = mem.reduce(function (s, m) { return s + m.v; }, 0), shown = mem.slice(0, 25).reverse();
      var gdm = plotIn('cty-mem-wrap');
      if (gdm && gdm.data) {
        try {
          Plotly.restyle(gdm, { x: [shown.map(function (m) { return m.v; })], y: [shown.map(function (m) { return entityName(m.c); })],
            text: [shown.map(function (m) { return pctTxt(m.v / mtot); })],
            hovertext: [shown.map(function (m) { return '<b>' + entityName(m.c) + '</b><br>' + fname + ': ' + fmtEur(m.v) + ' · ' + pctTxt(m.v / mtot) + ' of the region'; })],
            'marker.color': [sel.flow === 'IMPORT' ? '#0E8FC2' : '#D97A06'] }, [0]);
        } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
    // table of chapters
    if (window.jQuery && jQuery.fn.dataTable) {
      var tbl = document.querySelector('#cty-table table');
      if (tbl && jQuery.fn.dataTable.isDataTable(tbl)) {
        var dt = jQuery(tbl).DataTable();
        dt.clear().rows.add(chapters.map(function (c) { return [c.p, window.TRADE_PRODUCTS[c.p] || c.p, Math.round(c.imp), Math.round(c.exp), Math.round(c.exp - c.imp)]; })).draw(false);
      }
    }
  }

  // country selector <-> crosstalk selection (map click)
  function bindCountrySelect() {
    var el = document.getElementById('country_select'); if (!el) return;
    el.addEventListener('change', function () {
      var code = el.value;
      if (isAgg(code)) { highlightOnMap(null); updateCountry(); }      // map highlight = single countries only
      else if (window.crosstalkHandle) window.crosstalkHandle.set([code]);
      else { selectedPartner = code; highlightOnMap(code); updateEvolution(); updateCountry(); }
    });
  }

  // Crosstalk selection group shared by the map, the evolution chart and the data table
  function bindCrosstalk() {
    if (!window.crosstalk) return;
    var sh = new crosstalk.SelectionHandle(window.TRADE_GROUP || 'partner');
    window.crosstalkHandle = sh;
    sh.on('change', function (e) {
      var v = e.value;
      if (v && v.length) selectedPartner = v[v.length - 1];   // cleared selection -> keep the last partner
      highlightOnMap(v && v.length ? selectedPartner : null);
      var el = document.getElementById('country_select');
      if (el && v && v.length && !isAgg(selectedPartner)) el.value = selectedPartner;
      updateEvolution();
      updateCountry();
    });
    var gd = mapWidget();
    if (gd && gd.on) {
      gd.on('plotly_click', function (e) {
        var pt = e && e.points && e.points[0];
        if (pt && pt.customdata) sh.set([pt.customdata]);
      });
      gd.on('plotly_doubleclick', function () { sh.clear(); });
    }
    // initial selection: highlights the country on the map and in the table
    if (selectedPartner) { try { sh.set([selectedPartner]); } catch (e) {} }
  }

  function apply() {
    var sel = selection();

    // Widgets
    document.querySelectorAll('.keyed').forEach(function (wrap) {
      var gd = wrap.querySelector('.js-plotly-plot');
      if (!gd || !window.Plotly || !gd.data) return;
      var keys = JSON.parse(wrap.getAttribute('data-keys'));
      var want = keyFor(wrap.getAttribute('data-keyby'), sel);
      var vis = keys.map(function (k) { return k === want; });
      if (vis.indexOf(true) === -1) vis = keys.map(function () { return false; });
      // only the keyed traces: plotly/crosstalk appends its own highlight traces after them
      var idx = keys.map(function (_, i) { return i; });
      try { Plotly.restyle(gd, { visible: vis }, idx); } catch (e) {}
    });

    updateEvolution(sel);
    updateConcentration(sel);
    updateCountry(sel);

    // Titles + KPIs
    var pname = (window.TRADE_PRODUCTS || {})[sel.product] || sel.product;
    var fname = (window.TRADE_FLOWS || {})[sel.flow] || sel.flow;
    setText('main-title', fname + ' · ' + pname);
    setText('main-sub', sel.product === 'TOTAL' ? '' : 'HS2 chapter ' + sel.product);

    var k = (window.TRADE_KPI || {})[sel.product + SEP + sel.flow] || {};
    setText('kpi-total',    k.total_f    || '–');
    setText('kpi-partners', k.partners   != null ? k.partners : '–');
    setText('kpi-top1',     k.top1_f     || '–');
    setText('kpi-top1-note',k.top1_note  || '');
    setText('kpi-top5',     k.top5_f     || '–');
    setText('kpi-balance',  k.balance_f  || '–');
    setText('kpi-balance-note', k.balance_note || '');
  }

  function start() {
    document.querySelectorAll('#flow_pills input').forEach(function (i) { i.addEventListener('change', apply); });
    var p = document.getElementById('product_select');
    if (p) p.addEventListener('change', apply);
    var thr = document.getElementById('thr_range');
    if (thr) thr.addEventListener('input', function () { updateConcentration(); updateCountry(); });
    bindCountrySelect();
    document.querySelectorAll('#tab_pills input').forEach(function (i) { i.addEventListener('change', applyTab); });
    // htmlwidgets draws plotly after 'load'; retry until the widgets expose their data
    var tries = 0;
    (function init() {
      var ready = Array.prototype.every.call(document.querySelectorAll('.keyed'), function (w) {
        var gd = w.querySelector('.js-plotly-plot'); return gd && gd.data;
      });
      if (!ready && tries++ < 100) { setTimeout(init, 100); return; }
      apply();
      bindCrosstalk();
      // every widget was drawn with a real size (panels stacked, main invisible): now show one tab
      var root = document.querySelector('.cockpit');
      if (root) root.classList.add('ready');
      applyTab();
    })();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'complete') setTimeout(start, 0);
  else window.addEventListener('load', function () { setTimeout(start, 0); });
})();
</script>
```
